image.alt: A drawing of slender pointed bone tools with a repeating zigzag pattern cut into the shaft, lying on a dark surface.

beads.alt: A drawing of round flat ostrich-eggshell disc beads, each pierced in the centre, scattered together in a small group.

arrow.alt: A drawing of an arrow on a wooden surface: feathers at one end, and at the other end four sharp stone pieces tied along the shaft with cord.
